name: zig-analyzer
description: Zig Analyzer provides language server support for the Zig programming language.
author: Jassiel Ovando

zigAnalyzer.serverPath.description: Path to the zig-analyzer executable or its containing directory. Supports ${workspaceFolder}; if empty, the extension first looks in ${workspaceFolder}/zig-out/bin, then for `zig-analyzer` on PATH.

zigAnalyzer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the zig-analyzer language server.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.enable.description: Master switch for zig-analyzer inlay hints. When false, all inlay hint categories are disabled.

zigAnalyzer.enableSnippets.description: Enables snippet completions when the client also supports them.

zigAnalyzer.enableArgumentPlaceholders.description: Whether to enable function argument placeholder completions.

zigAnalyzer.completionLabelDetails.description: Whether to show the function signature in completion results. May improve readability in some editors when disabled.

zigAnalyzer.buildOnSave.enable.description: Whether to enable build-on-save diagnostics. When unset, enabled automatically if `build.zig` declares a `check` step.

zigAnalyzer.buildOnSave.args.description: Extra arguments passed to `zig build` for build-on-save. If `build.zig` declares a `check` step, that step is preferred over `install`.

zigAnalyzer.semanticTokens.description: Semantic token detail level. `partial` only includes information that requires semantic analysis.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.types.description: Show inferred-type inlay hints for const/var declarations.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.structLiteralFiel.description: Show inlay hints for fields in struct and union literals.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter-name inlay hints at call sites.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.builtins.description: Show inlay hints for builtin functions.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.excludeSingleArgu.description: Omit parameter-name inlay hints for calls with exactly one argument.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.hideRedundantPara.description: Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the identifier (e.g. `foo: foo`).
Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the last token of a parameter node (e.g. `foo: bar.foo`).

zigAnalyzer.formatter.enable.description: Whether the language server provides document formatting. When disabled, Format Document is a no-op from the server.

zigAnalyzer.formatter.command.description: Executable of a stdin/stdout formatter. When unset, the built-in formatter (matching `zig fmt`) is used. Must read the entire document from stdin and write the fully formatted result to stdout.

zigAnalyzer.formatter.args.description: Arguments passed to `formatter_command`. For `zig fmt`, use `["fmt", "--stdin"]`. Ignored when `formatter_command` is unset.

zigAnalyzer.referenceCodeLenses.description: Show reference counts as code lenses on declarations within the build-graph compilation unit.

zigAnalyzer.unusedDeclDiagnostics.description: Report unused private declarations as faded (Unnecessary) diagnostics. Public declarations are never reported.

zigAnalyzer.preferAstCheckAsChildProcess.description: Prefer running `zig ast-check` as a child process instead of the built-in AstGen path.

zigAnalyzer.builtinPath.description: Override the path to the `builtin` module. Automatically resolved if unset.

zigAnalyzer.libPath.description: Override the Zig library path. Automatically resolved from `zig_exe_path` when unset.

zigAnalyzer.zigPath.description: Path to the Zig executable (not the directory). If unset, `zig` is looked up in `PATH`.

zigAnalyzer.buildRunnerPath.description: Custom build runner used to resolve build system information.

zigAnalyzer.globalCachePath.description: Directory used as Zig's cache. Defaults to `${KnownFolders.Cache}/zig-analyzer`.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Executable paths (zigAnalyzer.serverPath, zigAnalyzer.zigPath, zigAnalyzer.formatter.command) are ignored in untrusted workspaces to prevent a workspace from silently configuring code execution.
